description: Don Bosco School FAQ Assistant - answers parent queries about fees, holidays, uniforms, timings, admissions

agentInfo.description: Answers frequent parent queries about fees, holidays, uniform, timings, admissions for Don Bosco Public School Hathaura

messages.textToSpeech: Namaste! Welcome to Don Bosco Public School Hathaura. How can I help you today? You can ask about admissions, fees, school timings, uniform, holidays, or contact details.

intents.name: School Timings
trainingPhrases: what time should I drop my child

messages.textToSpeech: School runs from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Monday to Friday. The office is open from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. On Saturdays, the office is open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

Annual fees range from ₹18,000 for Playgroup-UKG to ₹26,000 for Classes 4-6. Transport is optional at ₹4,000-5,000 per year. Fees are payable in two installments. For exact details, please visit our website's Admissions page or call 6201956001.

Our school uniform: Boys wear white shirt, navy blue pants, navy blue tie, and black shoes. Girls wear white kurta, navy blue salwar, navy blue dupatta, and black shoes. Winter uniform includes a navy blue sweater and blazer. Sports day uniform is a white T-shirt and navy blue shorts.

Summer vacation is from May to June. Diwali break is in October-November. Winter break is in late December. All major festivals are observed as holidays. Please check our School Calendar page for the complete list of holidays and events.

Admissions for 2025-26 are open! Visit our school office to collect the form. You'll need: birth certificate, previous report card, 2 passport photos, and parent ID. Minimum age for Playgroup is 2.5 years. For more details, visit our Admissions page or call 6201956001.
You can reach us at: Phone: +91 6201956001, Email: donbosco.hathaura@gmail.com. Address: Don Bosco Public School, Hathaura. Office hours: 8 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.

You can check your child's attendance, fee status, and homework online through our Parent Portal. Visit our website, click 'Parent Portal', and log in with your child's admission number. You can also install our app from Chrome browser - tap menu and 'Add to Home Screen'.
